Update supervoxel and root IDs in the SeaTable seed table

octo_update_ids.Rd

Looks up the supervoxel at each seed position (only where missing, unless refresh_supervoxels = TRUE), gets its current root ID, records root ID changes and flags neurons seeded more than once (see octo_flag_duplicates()). Read-only on the CAVE side.

Usage

octo_update_ids(
  table = getOption("octor.seatable_table"),
  coord_res = getOption("octor.voxel_size"),
  info_cols = c("cell_type", "group", "soma_side", "reconstructor", "annotator",
    "seymour_match_id"),
  refresh_supervoxels = FALSE,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  cols = NULL
)

Arguments

table

SeaTable table name

coord_res

voxel size (nm) of the positions

info_cols

columns whose filled-in values decide which row becomes primary when none is marked

refresh_supervoxels

look up supervoxels again for all rows

dry_run

compute everything but do not write to SeaTable

cols

named character vector to rename the expected columns, e.g. c(position = "xyz")

Value

invisibly, a data.frame with the new values per row

Details

Expected columns (names can be changed via cols): position (text, Spelunker voxel coordinates), supervoxel_id, root_id, root_id_previous, dup_status, same_as (text), root_changed_on, ids_checked_on (date), n_seeds (number), primary (checkbox). Keep the ID columns as Text: Number columns corrupt 64-bit IDs.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
res <- octo_update_ids(dry_run = TRUE)
table(res$dup_status)
octo_update_ids()
} # }
